name: Solarkin (Kineticist Archetype)
body:
Many kineticists surge with elemental fire, but only a handful of them are graced by the fire from the heart of the sun. While this hyperfocused solar might makes them extremely powerful and dangerous, most of them use their abilities for peacekeeping and healing.

Fire of the Sun (Su)

At 1st level, a solarkin must choose fire as his primary element. He can deal nonlethal damage with his kinetic blast, regardless of its type. A solarkin has to choose if his blast is to deal lethal or nonlethal damage before making an attack roll.

At 7th level, a solarkin must choose fire as his expanded element. He gains the positive blast (as the wood simple blast) as a bonus wild talent and thus gains access to the positive admixture composite blast in addition to the blue flame composite blast.

At 15th level, a solarkin must choose fire as his expanded element again. When making a kinetic blast, the solarkin can decide to infuse it with the power of the sun.

Half of the damage dealt by the blast is its normal damage type, and the other half results directly from divine power and is therefore not subject to being reduced by resistances or immunities.

This ability alters elemental focus and expanded element.

Basking (Ex)

At 5th level, when in conditions of bright light resulting from natural sunlight, a solarkin can reduce the combined burn cost of his blast infusions by 1 point more than his infusion specialization normally permits (2 at 5th level, 7 at 20th level).

If a solarkin is in conditions of darkness or supernatural darkness, he can reduce the combined burn cost of his blast infusions by 1 point less than his infusion specialization normally permits (0 at 5th level, 5 at 20th level).

This ability alters infusion specialization.

Healing Light (Su)

At 6th level, a solarkin gains kinetic healer as a bonus kinetic wild talent. In addition, once per day, he can infuse his kinetic blast with this healing energy. This works like a substance infusion costing 1 burn, converting all damage the kinetic blast would deal into healing. Unlike kinetic healer, this allows the blast to benefit from gather power, infusion specialization, metakinesis and other class abilities that affect infusions and kinetic blasts. A solarkin can infuse his kinetic blast with healing energy twice per day at 11th level and three times per day at 16th level.

This ability replaces internal buffer.

Fury of the Sun (Su)

At 20th level, a solarkin can accept 1 point of burn to ignore any energy resistances or immunities the target may possess with his blast.

This ability replaces omnikinesis.
